label: B25-PHYSICAL-ACCEPTANCE-AUDIT
title: Prepare an independent acceptance matrix for the selector physical rerun
scope: Independently derive the exact pass/fail acceptance matrix for T-20260909-002 from tracked candidate/QSF/SDC/MIF/checker contracts. Cover provenance, synthesis selector, M20K/MIF consumption, clocks, all timing gate classes, EMIF CDC filters, DDR/metastability, resources and forbidden artifacts/actions. Do not inspect the running physical worktree or remote probe.
validation: Map each acceptance claim to an exact Quartus report/query/artifact and fail-closed condition.

Include sys_clk_25=40 ns, MIF init recognition versus actual RAM consumption, setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse, T-045 filter resolve counts, EMIF/DDR checks and no-assembler/bitstream/JTAG proof.
Identify claims that cannot be made from synthesis-only or failed stages.
acceptance: A compact independent checklist can be applied to the returned evidence without remote access; no design/build/physical state is changed.
resource: Read-only/light only; no resource lock, no physical worktree/probe access and no remote connection.

integrator_review.usage: Apply all 14 rows fail-closed to the T-20260909-002 returned evidence; the matrix itself makes no physical PASS claim.

recovery.reason: User reported an abnormal local host restart; prior read-only agent terminated with no task artifacts or commits.
recovery.policy: Restart the same bounded read-only acceptance audit from the registered base.
